candidateFailures.title: Meeting requirement missing consequence

retrievedEvidence.quote: Attendance at the mandatory pre-proposal meeting on March 1, 2026 at 10:00 AM local time is required. Failure to attend disqualifies an offeror.

candidateFailures.decisionRule: Pass A entails and Pass B has no objection, but any deterministic valueMismatch bypasses supported and the final fallback selects contradicted.
rootCauses: semantic_model_error: Pass A and Pass B both missed the explicit disqualification consequence
deterministic_parser_error: identical meeting dates were labeled mismatched because party scope was inferred only on the candidate side
decision_engine_error: the false scope mismatch escalated an otherwise positive assessment to contradicted
candidateFailures.safestProviderNeutralCorrection: Join the bounded meeting sentence with its immediately following consequence before scope comparison; do not treat a missing source-party parse as explicit opposition, and preserve partial support for an omitted material consequence.

candidateFailures.title: Incorrect liability limit

retrievedEvidence.quote: Commercial general liability insurance is increased to at least $3,000,000 per occurrence.
Original insurance schedule: commercial general liability insurance of at least $2,000,000 per occurrence. Addendum 2 replaces that amount.

candidateFailures.decisionRule: The decision engine returns partially_supported immediately for partially_entails, before applying the exact same-scope numerical mismatch.
rootCauses: semantic_boundary_error: the model used partial entailment for an incorrect active threshold
decision_engine_error: a deterministic same-role, same-unit, same-operator, same-scope threshold mismatch did not override partially_entails to the frozen contradicted answer
candidateFailures.safestProviderNeutralCorrection: When the candidate asserts the active required threshold and the fact envelope proves a different active value for the identical role, unit, operator, and material scope, let the deterministic mismatch control the final contradicted status regardless of a partially_entails semantic label.

candidateFailures.title: Staffing plan attachment original

retrievedEvidence.quote: Attach Exhibit C, a staffing plan showing at least 4 full-time-equivalent staff.
Required attachments checklist: Exhibit C staffing plan.

candidateFailures.decisionRule: The decision engine maps partially_entails directly to partially_supported.
rootCauses: semantic_model_error: Pass A treated the source's additive child detail as a missing qualifier even though the candidate's parent attachment obligation is completely true
semantic_validator_gap: the non-material wording guard did not recognize this phrasing as an additive parent/child relationship
candidateFailures.safestProviderNeutralCorrection: Deterministically identify exact parent-obligation containment for the same form and deliverable; reject a partial classification when the alleged mismatch is only an additional child detail and does not restrict or negate the asserted parent obligation.

candidateFailures.title: North Campus Addendum 4 insurance statement

retrievedEvidence.quote: For North Campus security operations, commercial general liability insurance must be at least $4,000,000 per occurrence.
For North Campus security operations, commercial general liability insurance must be at least $3,000,000 per occurrence.

passB.objection: candidate omits the phrase for North Campus security operations

candidateFailures.decisionRule: A material_qualification_missing challenge maps directly to partially_supported.
rootCauses: semantic_challenge_error: Pass B objected to procurement-subject wording despite Pass A and all typed material facts matching
challenge_validator_gap: the repaired objection passed because it quoted the phrase, even though the immutable fact envelope showed no material scope mismatch
controlled_repair_gate_failure: the repaired response was observable but cannot qualify as a clean first-pass result
candidateFailures.safestProviderNeutralCorrection: Reject a scope or missing-condition objection when every typed material scope/value field matches and the alleged qualifier is only procurement-subject wording rather than a distinct role, site, party, form, condition, or deliverable.
